text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Now, the Umamusume are all gearing up 
for their final spurt!! The sprint begins 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit...! My body feels so heavy... My 
legs are getting dragged down...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is moving up!! She's making her 
charge from the back!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (She's... closing in on me!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Like hell... I'm gonna stop...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: W O O O O A A A R R H H ! ! ! !

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—It's Katsuragi Ace!! Katsuragi Ace is in 
the lead!! Katsuragi Ace, Katsuragi Ace!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*— *hack*... 
*cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Ngh, this is bad...—)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Are your legs alright? Does anything feel 
off?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine...ーー I just... lost... my 
strength... that's allーー

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —You were amazing, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Today's race was so, so thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the Japanese 
Derby. —I won't lose next time."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Aah— Look at 'em, having so much fun—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I can barely even stand... I don't even 
have the energy to celebrate, damn it—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't even feel like... I won... damn 
it—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: …………Ace-san――

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! Are you kidding 
me?! Did my Triple Crown dream just end 
out of nowhere!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No way…… I wanted to see CB win……――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ah, no way... Ace-chan won, so why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"...We were right there watching, you 
know! The victory you seized, S-cchi...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the Satsuki Sho was remembered 
not for Katsuragi Ace's victory, but as 
Mr. C.B.'s narrow defeat—"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—With the Satsuki Sho behind us, just 
what kind of race will the upcoming 
Japanese Derby turn out to be?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"C.B. remains the undisputed favorite. 
After all, even with the track conditions 
being disadvantageous for a chaser like 
her during the Satsuki Sho, she pulled 
through."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, such a development was perhaps 
unavoidable. I'm certain she will 
demonstrate her true capabilities at the 
Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"It'll certainly be worth watching to see 
who steps up to challenge Mr. C.B."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""In my view, Sheena Frejus is a strong 
contender. She hails from a lineage of 
Umamusume with proven success over long 
distances, inheriting both the talent and 
technique.""

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"‘As the distance increases from the Derby 
to the Kikuka Sho, her stability should 
only grow. The one who will truly become 
CB's rival is likely her—’"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――Haha. I won, yet I barely get any 
coverage.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...It's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not about living up to this 
reputation. It's about... who I am—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She's trembling... thinking that she might 
not be able to beat C.B. next time...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"After crossing the finish line at the 
Satsuki Sho, I was completely at my limit 
and couldn't even stand up, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She was so full of life. If anything, she 
looked even bigger... and stronger than 
before she started running.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And that was the first time... I ever felt 
scared.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And that... is so frustrating... 
dammit...!
choice_data_list: —However, the one who won is you.
—Still, you were the one who won.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list: I saw it clearly. I remember it all.

I'm watching it closely. And I'll remember 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable Mr. C.B. was, 
Katsuragi Ace boldly challenged her and 
seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Mr. C.B. gets stronger, then Katsuragi 
Ace just has to get stronger too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace won the Satsuki Sho 
precisely because she pushed herself like 
crazy to get stronger. She can do the 
exact same thing at the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I believe in that―― even more than 
Katsuragi Ace does……!!"
choice_data_list: So let's win the Japan Derby too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Standing in front of Katsuragi Ace, I 
clenched my fist tightly, just like she 
did.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're seriously such an idiot 
sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that side of you is super cool, 
and you're so reliable!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to that, I can act like a total 
fool and fight with all I've got...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trembling or scared, it doesn't matter! 
All I gotta do is push past every bit of 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's—what an "ace" is all about!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Aiming for the Japanese Derby, 
let's do this, let's do thiiis!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting our arms around each other's 
shoulders, we raised our fists to the sky. 
With our spirits fired up... we march 
forward to the next decisive battle, the 
Japanese Derby!
